notes: v504 — a fix to something the app was saying that it had not earned the right to say. If the honest grading could not be reached, the evidence panel quietly fell back to an older method that judged a signal by how OFTEN it fired rather than by whether it was right — and that method has no way of answering 'we looked and found nothing'. So every one of the nineteen signals came back with a confident verdict, some marked proven, some marked losing, and the NOT PROVEN count read zero. That is impossible on the real grading, where all nineteen sit well inside their own margin of error. The numbers were wrong, but the claim was worse: the panel said 'edge at least 2.5x its own margin of error' about a figure that had never been near that test. Now an ungraded signal reads TOO EARLY, earns no badge, and is never called losing; a stored grading from an older grader is discarded instead of being reused all day; and when any signal has not been properly graded the panel says so on the line itself, in gold. If you have been seeing SOLID counts in the hundreds, they were never real — zero is the honest answer today, and the app should now say so plainly. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
